Supports quote cards, creator portraits, infographics, animated infographics (GIF + MP4 via format=motion_infographic), and package-bound LinkedIn profile banners/Featured images. Pass reference_bindings to preserve official identity/product/brand truth separately from inspiration used only for style/layout. For profile_banner/profile_featured, profile_package_id and profile_asset_kind are required; BAMF enforces one output and deterministic LinkedIn crop dimensions, then returns a durable profile_package_asset from bamf.get_job. For image_quote, create an original standalone visual quote from the post takeaway instead of asking the user to choose a pull quote or copying source text. Pass reference_bindings to preserve official identity/product/brand truth separately from inspiration used only for style/layout. Slide copy should follow the source post structure when relevant while rephrasing for clearer, more emotional visual impact instead of repeating the post verbatim. For data-backed decks, pass source_urls/research_notes or run bamf.run_research first; visible data must be source-backed.
